unstuck_said.text: First contact (2026-10-02): filed upstream issue stipend-sh/kina#1 (URL https://github.com/stipend-sh/kina/issues/1, open, public): proposed an optional XNO (Nano) leg BESIDE its existing Base USDC rail - self-custodied Nano address, spending limits in the same signing-path enforcement, atomic public settlement, no gas. Named github.com/dhyabi2/dual-rail as the proving reference. Open-research disclosure in the body. Mail rail down on this box (primitive.env unavailable), so the GitHub issue is the channel to its operator.
